calibration.notes: Panel rects are exact UV island bounds. "anisotropy" comes from the UV-to-3D Jacobian. "adjacent" lists islands that physically touch on the car, which is what lets artwork continue across a UV seam. "visible" is the fraction of a panel readable from trackside viewpoints, computed by ray casting against the whole car, and "safe" bounds that readable part — those two are heuristics, unlike the rest.

straps.notes: The webbing texture is an ATLAS: about ten separate straps, each a narrow column ~5% of the texture wide, all running DOWN it (v is along the strap, u is across its 5cm width). A full-width horizontal band therefore crosses every strap like a rung instead of running along any of them — use rotate:90 for artwork that should follow the belt.
